COMMAND.name: terminal length
COMMAND.help: Set lines per page for paged output (0 = paging off, dump all)

PARAM.name: lines
PARAM.help: Lines per page (0-512; 0 disables the pager)

COMMAND.ACTION: mkdir -p /etc/titian echo "${lines}" > /etc/titian/terminal-length if [ "${lines}" = "0" ]; then echo "Terminal pager disabled (length 0)"; else echo "Terminal length set to ${lines} lines"; fi

COMMAND.name: terminal no-more
COMMAND.help: Disable the pager for this session (same as terminal length 0)

COMMAND.name: terminal more
COMMAND.help: Re-enable the pager for this session (default length 24)
